name: task-manager
description: Connect Task Manager to find, inspect, create, update, and comment on work safely.

interface.shortDescription: Find and manage Task Manager data safely.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Task Manager with OAuth, find work across accessible projects and releases, resolve canonical references, inspect complete task context and current versions, create or update tasks safely, and work with native task comments. Delivery lifecycle, Goals, verification, releases, report content, and terminal status remain the responsibility of the calling workflow.
